actual_scope: Under the zero-swap, one-scale hypotheses of open PR #7030, every rational elementary word for the pinned helper-462 matcher has at least 9 shears. Subadditivity of rank(W - I) still gives only 8 and meets the matrix. The elementary rank-drop depth is at most 2 on every scale row, so length 8 is impossible. The recorded 29-shear word remains an upper bound. No supplier admission and no new kappa.
scope_change_reason: Open question 2 of PR #7030 asks whether the rank lower bound of 8 on a one-scale zero-swap helper-462 word can be raised. Subadditivity of rank(W - I) meets 8 on the recorded matrix, so the question requires a different invariant. This package names the elementary rank-drop depth, evaluates it on that recorded word, and proves the bound 9. It does not audit supplier admission, shorten the 29-shear word, or change the selected frontier.
bottleneck_link: A later helper-462 generator that keeps this alphabet cannot use a one-scale zero-swap word with fewer than 9 shears. That is a letter-count constraint only. It is not a paid bill, a supplier admission, or a change to the selected kappa.
stop_rule: Stop when the rank-drop census on all eight scale rows is complete and length 8 is closed. Do not search lengths 9 through 28 and do not rebuild the 29-shear word.
evidence: Exact rational census of the elementary rank-drop tree of D^{-1} S for every scale row. The minor test and the pairing test agree on every edge. Depth is 2 on the recorded row-0 matrix and at most 2 on the other rows, while rank(D^{-1} S - I) = 8. An explicit 8-shear matrix in SL(8) peels back to I, and diag(2, 1/2) has depth 0. The recorded 29-shear word multiplies to the pinned matcher. Selected kappa stays 781451/250000000.

open_questions.question: Can the elementary shear lower bound be raised above 9 under the same zero-swap, one-scale hypotheses?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Length 8 is impossible and the recorded word has 29 shears. The integers 9 through 28 are still open, so 9 is not known to be sharp.
open_questions.first_step: Name an invariant that charges one shear which does not drop rank(· - I), and evaluate it on the same recorded 29-shear word.
open_questions.blocked_by: A non-dropping step has a coefficient that the rank-drop equation does not fix, so the set of length-9 words over Q is infinite. This census does not decide it. An explicit word shorter than 29 is open question 1 of #7030 and is not taken here.
